scope: Current production source, in-memory real HTTP/WebSocket server; no comparative latency measurement.

observations.name: duplicate_history_and_destroy_signals
observations.limitation: Real HTTP response acquired before a delivery gate; verifies caller signals and late-response guards, not wasted body-transfer bytes.

observations.name: ephemeral_growth
observations.transport: real gateway sender and reader socket; no external command service
observations.limitation: Injected at production gateway's private-response boundary; no end-to-end slash-command provider call or renderer memory timing.

observations.name: choice_overlap_and_post_destroy_repair
observations.transport: real writes; first pin delayed before forwarding
observations.limitation: Intentional API forwarding gate; confirms lifecycle/concurrency boundary, not an ordinary final-state convergence failure or an auth bypass.

observations.name: destroyed_choice_overrides_replacement_intent
observations.transport: same account/token, real replacement connection and real HTTP writes; first old write gated before forwarding
observations.limitation: Account token intentionally stays valid across workspace close/reopen; no logout or authorization bypass.

observations.name: logout_revocation_control
observations.interpretation: Callback still tries a repair after logout, but server session revocation rejects it; no auth bypass.
